Metal rolls are the consumable working element of rolling mills — cast or forged in alloy steel, spheroidal graphite iron, high-chrome iron, adamite, graphite steel, indefinite-chill or tungsten carbide — which shape billets, blooms and slabs into finished long and flat steel; because they wear continuously, they are replaced on average every 5-10 weeks, making demand a consumable annuity that CRISIL describes as 'perfectly and …

strategy.title: Strategies (RHP)
strategy.body:
- Continue strengthening technological capabilities, enhancing operational efficiency and maintaining high standards of product quality and consistency in gravure cylinder/roller manufacturing.
- Invest in technology, automation, precision manufacturing, quality improvement and process efficiency across gravure, flexographic and digital printing over the next decade.
- Focus on timely delivery, customer satisfaction, process optimisation and adoption of appropriate technological advancements to remain a reliable partner to customers in the gravure printing and flexible packaging ecosystem.
